targetFunction.name: readBodyData
targetFunction.signature: public int readBodyData(OutputStream output) throws MalformedStreamException, IOException

subject.requirement: Read the body data of the current multipart encapsulation up to, but excluding, the next boundary. Write the body bytes to the supplied output stream when it is non-null, discard them when output is null, return the number of body bytes processed, preserve the boundary state for the following readBoundary call, and do not close the caller-owned output stream. Unexpected end-of-stream or malformed multipart input must be reported through the target API's checked exceptions. The C# reference supplies behavioral evidence; Java streaming and exception conventions remain authoritative.

reasons: MultipartStream has corresponding public APIs and responsibilities in both projects.
The target method is a streaming adaptation from C# Stream to Java OutputStream.
The target project already provides ItemInputStream and Streams.copy helpers for boundary-aware copying.

behaviorMapping.requirement: Process only the current multipart body and stop before the next boundary.
candidateEvidence: The C# implementation reads the current parsed part body.
The Java ItemInputStream stops at the boundary separator.
behaviorMapping.targetAction: Copy from a new boundary-aware ItemInputStream.

behaviorMapping.requirement: Write body bytes when an output is supplied and support discard mode when it is null.
candidateEvidence: The C# implementation conditionally writes to the supplied stream.
behaviorMapping.targetAction: Delegate nullable output handling to the existing Streams.copy helper.

behaviorMapping.requirement: Return the number of body bytes processed without closing the caller output.
candidateEvidence: The C# implementation returns the body length and leaves the output lifetime to the caller.
behaviorMapping.targetAction: Return the copy count and pass false for closeOutputStream.

contractMapping.note: Java preserves the nullable discard convention through the existing copy utility.
The target API returns int as declared by the existing method contract.

implementationPlan: Create a boundary-aware ItemInputStream for the current encapsulation.
Copy its bytes to the caller output without closing that output.
Return the number of copied bytes and allow existing checked exceptions to propagate.
risks: The Java target streams data incrementally while the C# reference materializes parsed parts.
The target project contains unrelated skeleton TODOs outside this selected method.
assumptions: The existing ItemInputStream preserves the boundary for readBoundary().
Streams.copy accepts a null output for discard mode and does not close it when requested.

implementationNotes: Do not reimplement the multipart boundary scanner in the translated method.
